S1lifecycle.key: (tabId, netKey, siteAddress); created only by a user action (omnibox or extension UI)
S1lifecycle.ends: tab closed, or the user navigates to another address or network
S1lifecycle.frames: frames created by site_navigate or reload join the session and renew no budget; one LoadJob per session; navigation cancels the previous LoadJob; its orphan chunk requests stay in CONTENT_POOL until they settle; blob URLs of the previous load are revoked on teardown; messages from a torn-down frame's port are dropped after it closes and consume no token
orphanStates: live -> orphan (teardown: aborted, no reply, counter unchanged)
orphan -> settled (transport promise rejected, receive buffer and reservation released; counter -1)
the longest time to settle is the transport timeout
bounds: messages accepted by second t <= 50 + 50 t
each chunk fetched once while it stays cached
